text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 237 million markka median forecast for mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 7 at 1000 (0700 GMT).
In January-August 1995, Outokumpu posted a 1.32 billion markka profit.
Outokumpu said on September 2 its May-August results would be clearly weaker than in January-April, and that the full-year 1996 result would be significantly weaker than in 1995.

For Outokumpu's full-year 1996 profit, 10 of the 15 analysts polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items, before extraordinaries of 556 million markka (mean 548 million) in a 410-767 million markka range. The corresponding 1995 profit was 1.48 billion markka.
The data was collected in the last week of September and on October 3.

Contributors to the survey were ABB Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FSB Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita, Opstock and Postipankki.
